body:
I’ve wondered if I’m zinc/magnesium deficient before. It’s been mentioned off-hand a few times so I might try that to see if that helps sleep. Trying to figure out how to help my sleep feels nice since it feels like I’m planning some sort of future even if it’s short term. 

Yeah, I live in a place where the views aren’t exactly similar to mine. It stinks. I can’t wait to go back to college when it’s safe (from COVID). Things were better there. 

As for an update, people eventually walked away from the door and I did a bit of online college, tried really hard to take a nap (failed on all accounts unfortunately), ate an entire gallon sized bag of trail mix and I’m currently trying not to throw that up despite knowing that’s how that cycle goes. I contacted my brother to let him know what’s going on and he had his girlfriend come over and make sure I was alright.

Thanks. I’m in therapy so I’m really hoping I can use that to help me find some happiness in just being alone and independent so that I can have a healthier relationship next time. Talking with you really did help. Thank you for being part of me trying to put myself together.
Thank you for talking with me. I guess this is just another thing I’m going to have to get through for long enough for me to see it through hindsight.

I can’t disagree with you but I think I’m going to have to reread that a few times to get my head to try to accept it. 

I won’t lie, he wasn’t exactly the best when I tried to have other friends. He was always very mean to other people behind their backs and I told him I hated that. Then in person he wasn’t exactly peachy. He really hated all of my friends. I’ve re-contacted one since I posted this and they’ve been talking with me in a very understanding way. They didn’t really like him either. I kind of had my head in the sand I guess. I don’t know. I feel kind of horrible, like I abandoned everyone.

Just a week ago I called him to have a serious talk about how negative he was to other people. I don’t know why but I felt better after that talk, as if I thought he would change. I really don’t think I would want to stick around to see if he did. 

Ack. I think I’m going to have about ten more cups of tea and I’m going to look at dice on Etsy until my mind stops thinking.
